policy: Research informs independently authored tasks. No raw paper text or third-party dataset row enters this pilot. Dataset licensing is separate from repository licensing. Existing model and software revisions stay pinned.

scientific_sources.title: What Do CAE Simulation Agents Really Need Beyond a Generic Harness?
scientific_sources.use: Tutorial-grounded generation, bounded execution repair, and physics checks distinct from completion. Strong hosted backbones, single runs and historical specialized baselines limit transfer to local 1.5B.

scientific_sources.title: IteraSim RAG
scientific_sources.status: preprint submitted to Computer Physics Communications
scientific_sources.use: Preserve solver-version knowledge and configuration dependencies. Reported reference executions target ESI v2506; do not transfer its decks to v2312 or Foundation 14.

scientific_sources.title: Learning Hierarchical and Geometry-Aware Graph Representations for Text-to-CAD
scientific_sources.use: Explicit graph constraints and progressively harder structural edits. BlendGeo is Blender code, not PicoGK; no rows imported.

scientific_sources.title: FutureCAD: Towards High-Fidelity CAD Generation via LLM-Driven Program Generation and Text-Based B-Rep Primitive Grounding
scientific_sources.use: Ground face/edge selection before advanced CAD operations. Author data notes overlapping parent models in grounding splits; regroup by parent before future training/evaluation.

scientific_sources.title: CADBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for AI-Assisted CAD Program Generation
scientific_sources.use: Keep evaluation data out of training and measure geometry separately from executability. Current Qwen is text-only; no image-conditioned reconstruction claim.

scientific_sources.title: CAD-Coder: Text-to-CAD Generation with Chain-of-Thought and Geometric Reward
scientific_sources.use: SFT before geometry-based reinforcement learning. Syntax or Chamfer rewards alone do not establish attachment correctness. This pilot uses SFT, not GRPO.

scientific_sources.title: CAD-Recode: Reverse Engineering CAD Code from Point Clouds
scientific_sources.use: Editable Python construction histories. Repository CC-BY-NC-4.0 prevents treating it as an unrestricted commercial training source; excluded from this pilot.

scientific_sources.title: rStar-Coder: Scaling Competitive Code Reasoning with a Large-Scale Verified Dataset
scientific_sources.use: Independently verified input/output pairs; preserve source/test identities and reject unverified solutions. Broad competitive programming does not replace CFD or CAD oracles.

scientific_sources.title: Foam-Agent
scientific_sources.use: Dependency-consistent decks, tutorial retrieval and log-based repair. Benchmarks are external evaluation leads, not imported training examples.

data_and_api_sources.title: PicoGK
data_and_api_sources.role: API reference for authored graphs; installed DLL and native-library hashes are checked separately

data_and_api_sources.title: OpenUSD Hello World
data_and_api_sources.role: API reference only; the current development docs are 26.11, so the existing native 25.5 interpreter determines pilot compatibility

data_and_api_sources.title: OpenFOAM Foundation 14 applications
data_and_api_sources.role: Version distinction: foamRun loads solver modules. No Foundation-14 native validation in the ESI-v2312 witness

data_and_api_sources.title: OpenFOAM cavity tutorial
data_and_api_sources.role: Conceptual reference. Native witness uses the installed ESI-v2312 cavity, not this older Foundation deck
data_and_api_sources.license: Installed OpenFOAM tutorial GPL-3.0; no tutorial files committed

data_and_api_sources.title: Foam-Agent source
data_and_api_sources.role: Research/reference only; OpenFOAM tutorial and benchmark data require their own provenance

data_and_api_sources.title: rStar-Coder dataset
data_and_api_sources.role: Future streaming source; require row-level verification, attribution, benchmark deduplication and execution filtering. No rows imported; full download exceeds 480 GB

data_and_api_sources.title: GenCAD-Code
data_and_api_sources.role: Excluded: official dataset card has no explicit dataset licence; repository Apache licence does not settle data rights. Image/code pairs also need multimodal conditioning

data_and_api_sources.title: FutureCAD dataset documentation
data_and_api_sources.role: Candidate pending dataset licence confirmation and conversion/native execution. Parent-model overlaps in grounding splits require regrouping

data_and_api_sources.title: Python arithmetic
data_and_api_sources.role: Bounded AST interpreter for authored dimensional-analysis calculations; no exec/eval of model output
